title: skills(pm-dispatch): the NORTH-STAR p2/p3 dispatch gate reads repo-wide open P0/P1; maintainer ruling makes it read the lane's own queue
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`) at 2026-09-24T14:08Z, **on the maintainer's instruction**. ⛔ Not graded or routed; that is triage's job. The maintainer named the card class: "skills".

## Maintainer ruling (verbatim, from this seat's session, 2026-09-24T14:08Z)

> 当前车道队列中如果已经没有 p0 p1，就应该可以派其他卡。这应该提交一个 skills 卡。

(English: "If the current lane's queue has no p0/p1 left, other cards should be dispatchable. This should be filed as a skills card.")

## What the text says today

- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 「优先级」 item 3 (line 114 on `origin/main`): 「产品仓还有开放的 P0/P1 时,任何车道不派 p2/p3 的工具卡、契约卫生卡;解锁产品 P0/P1 的仪器卡沿链继承其优先级。」
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:45`: 「取卡前置 = `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`「优先级」第 3 条:产品仓开放 P0/P1 每次取卡现读。」

⇒ The gate reads **repo-wide** open P0/P1, across objectstack and objectui. At this reading, objectstack has 4 P0 / 34 P1 and objectui 0 P0 / 6 P1, while the `domain:spec` @ objectui lane queue holds **zero** P0/P1. So the lane sat idle on p2 work that no P0/P1 in its own queue was competing with. That is the situation the ruling corrects.

## Asked change

Make the gate's reading **lane-scoped**: a lane may dispatch its p2/p3 tooling and contract-hygiene cards when **its own queue** has no open P0/P1. The unlock-chain inheritance clause stays as is. Surfaces to edit, all governed:
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 「优先级」 item 3: the rule itself;
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:45`: the take-card precondition that reads it;
- any other reader of the same rule. Grep `产品仓开放 P0/P1` / `产品仓还有开放的 P0/P1` across `.claude/**`, `skills/**` and `docs/**`; the seat's scan found only these two.

⚠️ `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is Tier H: the PR needs the maintainer's approval to land. `.claude/**` is Tier S.

## Open points for triage and the implementer, not re-ruled here

- The lane definition when one lane has several seats (`domain:X#N`), and for cross-repo lanes such as `domain:spec @ objectui`: the ruling says 「当前车道队列」 (the current lane's queue).
- Whether a lane's `pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` P0/P1 cards count as "in the queue".

## In effect now

The ruling applies from the moment it was given, per SKILL.md 优先级 「维护者裁决 > 北极星」. The `domain:spec` @ objectui seat is dispatching under it now, with this card as the carrier.
